name: Changelog
description: Product release notes grouped by month with change-type filters and counts, search across versions, unread-since-last-visit markers, plan tags and paging.

props.name: entries
props.description: Releases with version, ISO date, title, changes and plans

props.name: lastSeen
props.description: ISO date of last visit; newer releases are marked New

props.name: pageSize
props.description: Releases per page before Load older (default 5)

props.name: onMarkAllRead
props.description: Shows the Mark all as read button
